metadata.description: Mayank's stack of Claude Code plugins for development and continuous improvement workflows

plugins.name: ccimprove
plugins.description: Analyze Claude Code usage patterns to continuously improve workflows, skills, and plugins

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Development workflow commands, skills, and doc-conventions. Code review, quality gates, engineering practices, and documentation templates with workflow enforcement.

plugins.name: download
plugins.description: Download content from various sources (YouTube, X, Notion, Scribd, arXiv, blogs) as local Markdown files, and digitize Vedic astrology charts to JSON + ASCII

plugins.name: company-setup
plugins.description: Tools for forming a company. The check-name skill sweeps USPTO trademarks, the WA Secretary of State, and major domain registrars and produces a single aggregated availability report.

plugins.name: think
plugins.description: Parallel divergent ideation for coding agents. The adhd skill spawns N isolated reasoning branches under different cognitive frames, scores them, prunes traps, and deepens the survivors — escaping premature convergence on architecture, naming, API design, fuzzy debugging, and strategy. Vendored from UditAkhourii/adhd.
